old.text: Reporting a security incident A security incident is anything that puts the confidentiality, integrity or availability of Institute information at risk: for example a lost laptop, an email sent to the wrong person, a successful phishing attack, a suspicious sign-in or a door to a secure area left open. Report every incident, or anything you think might be one, to the service desk within 24 hours of noticing it. Use the incident form on the staff portal or call the service desk; outside working hours the phone line is answered by the on-call security officer. Do not try to investigate the incident yourself, delete evidence or contact the people involved, unless the security team asks you to. Reporting quickly matters more than knowing every detail, and you will not be blamed for reporting something that turns out to be harmless. Some incidents involving personal data must be reported to the data protection authority within 72 hours. The security team decides whether that is necessary, which is why early reports from staff are so important.
